stories.title: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza
stories.summary: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza Netanyahu's office said in a statement on Sunday that Israel gave Hamas a three-day deadline to halt the kite launches, threatening a broad air assault if they continued, and said it would evacuate areas of Gaza from which balloons, drones and paper kites are launched. Over the weekend, Israeli media reported that several kites, believed to be launched from Gaza, had landed near Israeli settlements adjacent to Gaza, noting that they were not carrying explosives and posed no danger. stories.headline: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza

opening: Israel warns of strikes, evacuations over kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza Netanyahu's office said in a statement on Sunday that Israel gave Hamas a three-day deadline to halt the kite launches, threatening a broad air assault if they continued, and said it would evacuate areas of Gaza from which balloons, drones and paper kites are launched.

Over the weekend, Israeli media reported that several kites, believed to be launched from Gaza, had landed near Israeli settlements adjacent to Gaza, noting that they were not carrying explosives and posed no danger.
